upcomingProjects.name: Edge-AI Fall Detection
upcomingProjects.description:
Built a lightweight edge-AI fall detection system that combines human pose estimation, motion dynamics, temporal reasoning, and occlusion recovery to distinguish genuine falls from normal activities such as sitting, lying down, and sleeping.

The system is designed to remain reliable even when furniture partially occludes the person, while maintaining lightweight real-time CPU inference.

Research Question:
How can temporal and anatomical reasoning make vision-based fall detection robust to occlusion and false positives while remaining lightweight enough for real-time CPU inference?

upcomingProjects.name: Mave — AI Desktop Companion
upcomingProjects.description:
Mave is a lightweight AI desktop companion designed to make AI accessible without constantly switching between applications.

It can be summoned through a mouse gesture or cursor interaction, allowing users to quickly search for information, capture ideas, save notes, and organize thoughts into projects.

Instead of functioning as another standalone chatbot, Mave acts as a personal AI layer around the cursor—appearing when needed and staying out of the way otherwise.

Over time, Mave builds a searchable personal memory of projects, ideas, notes, and research, creating an AI workspace that is always one small interaction away.
